name: worker-lidger
description: Personal income and expense ledger for Cloudflare Workers and D1

WORKER_API_TOKEN.description: Required private bearer token. Generate and paste a unique random value; this template has no usable default. Save the raw value for the iPhone Shortcut (without the Bearer prefix) and never commit it.

DB.description: D1 database that stores categories, ledger entries, and installment schedules. Cloudflare provisions it during one-click deployment.
